main_text.p: quent', dudum ostenderunt nostri Theologi & inter hos Pareus Rom. c. 13. Cl. Rivetus p. 259 260. post Reinoldum Theologum Anglum doctissimum.

Secundum genus calumniarum consistit in effectis & adjunctis perniciosis scilicet, quę huic doctrinæ Bellarm. & alii Pontificii adscribunt. Quod quidem ab ipsis fieri mirum non est; Certum quippe est nullam doctrinam magis ipsorum ambitioni & contrariam & exosam esse, quàm hęc quidem est. Quæ etiam causa est, quòd, ut dudum grauissimus Theologus Pareus in Aphorismis questus est, nolunt permittere Principibus, ut intelligant, quantum potestatis in rebus Ecclesiasticis habeant. Primò ajunt confundi eâ ratione omnia, potestatem scilicet Magistratus cum ministerio Ecclesiastico. Ita olim Hardingum contra Ecclesiæ Anglicanæ Apologiam contendebat. Ita Bellarm. lib. 1. de Cleric. c. 28,

page.notes: Chapter marker "Ǫ. XIV." (caput 14) appears in the running head at top right; it is not part of the running title. Doubtful readings: "quent'," at the top of the page (line may continue a word from the previous page); "Anglum" with an unusual g-form. Printed line "Ita olim" is split by a line-end hyphen, read as two words. The page ends with the catchword "Secundò" at the right, which is recorded only in bottom_margin.
